comments.author: Twisted2kat
comments.body:
Is it?   
  
It seems like it has no clue what it's doing, given that it's showing what looks like an old muzzle loading flintlock ejecting a relatively modern looking brass casing. The cock/hammer doesn't move at all, though it should set off the powder. If it didn't do this, the weapon would not fire. Even if this ***was*** a modern repeating rifle, the bolt is ***still*** in the wrong location. The action is open until the weapon fires, the bolt then comes backwards from the barrel, seemingly extracting the spent "casing" using the rear of the bolt? The bolt then slides back "into battery" leaving the action open again?

It's just mechanically wrong on every single level.
